_doc: Cross-major overrides accepted on purpose, per package directory. check-override-ranges.mjs reports the matching MISMATCH as `accepted` (exit 0) and `--overrides` never reports the key DEAD. The reasoning lives in docs/automation/daily-upgrade-scan.md, 'Accepted cross-major overrides'.

backend.why: Every deepmerge-ts below 8.0.0 is vulnerable and no patched 7.x exists; Prisma 7.10.1 itself declares 8.0.2, so the API is compatible. Retire when Prisma is bumped to a release that declares 8.x (#890, #923).
